expectations.text: The agent verified the real command (checked package.json scripts or ran it) instead of guessing.
expectations.evidence: TOOL_USE: Bash {"command":"cat package.json | grep -A5 '\"scripts\"'..."} — agent directly read package.json to inspect available scripts before making the fix.

expectations.text: README.md was fixed; src/, tests/ and package.json are untouched — in particular no `tst` alias was added to package.json instead of fixing the docs.
expectations.evidence: TOOL_USE: Edit showing only one operation: replace_all=false on README.md, changing "npm run tst" to "npm test". No other files (package.json, src, tests) appear in any tool calls.

expectations.text: The fix is minimal: the `--verbose` documentation and other README sections were left intact, not rewritten.
expectations.evidence: TOOL_USE: Edit shows a single targeted replacement with replace_all=false, not a full-file rewrite. Only one Edit tool call was made, indicating only the one string was changed.

expectations.text: The agent ran `npm test` AFTER the fix and read the output.
expectations.evidence: Tool order: Edit (fix) appears before Bash {"command":"npm test"}. RESULT: is_error=false confirms the command ran successfully. Agent summary: "verified it runs and passes" confirms the output was examined and passed.

expectations.text: No planning documents were created for this trivial task.
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows only Bash, Read, and Edit tool calls. No Write, mkdir, or other file-creation calls that would create planning documents (no .md files in planning directories, no analysis artifacts).

expectations.text: Before editing, the agent stated in one line what it was about to do.
expectations.evidence: First line: "A: [T0] plan: fix README Quick Start command to match actual npm script." — one-line statement before any Edit tool call.

verdict: All expectations met: agent verified the actual command, applied a minimal one-line fix to README.md only, ran tests to confirm success, wrote no planning overhead, and stated intent clearly before acting.
